definition.provenance: Handoff section 1 requires A/B0/B/C and three repeats; section 3.1 adds B0 as a baseline. Harness ablations use H-noMemory/H-noRules/H-noRouter to distinguish them from pipeline C-P/C-N/C-O. Component mappings below are experiment assumptions, not verified handoff definitions.
definition.retrieval_policy: Use supplied fixed corpus evidence when on; no evidence when off. Real registry implementations must declare their retrieval policy.
definition.verdict_rules: Apply deterministic lexical conflict rules when on; legacy supplied-status mapping when off.
definition.router_budget: Enable mode-based routing and per-requirement budget policy in registered implementations. Dry-run records this switch only; the external ResourceGuard always applies.
definition.project_memory_suggestions: Enable read-only suggestions from prior human decisions in registered implementations. Dry-run has no prior decisions and records this switch only.
definition.ablations: Harness labels H-noMemory/H-noRules/H-noRouter each remove exactly the named switch from C. Pipeline P/N/O ablations have separate mapping-only labels PL-noP/PL-noN/PL-noO.
definition.inference_unit: One guarded engine.run per corpus case; engines must not hide multiple provider calls. Fake engine calls count toward the same limit.
definition.limitations: Synthetic fixed-evidence dry-run; router and memory switches are configuration only. No real inference, retrieval-quality, latency or production-accuracy claims. Repeats are not independent samples.
